item.title: 'It's surreal': Zimbabwe superfans revel in unexpected ride to India
item.description: A group of Zimbabwe superfans told AFP "it felt surreal" to be watching their team in the Super Eights in India -- days after the colourful group had returned home thinking their T20 World Cup odyssey was over.Then a sponsor stepped in and a few days later the colourful band were back in the cricketing cauldron of Chennai to witness their idols face India in a Super Eights showdown.

item.title: Thunder beat Nuggets in overtime on Gilgeous-Alexander's return
item.description: The Oklahoma City Thunder celebrated star Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's injury return with a hard-fought 127-121 NBA overtime victory over Nikola Jokic and the Denver Nuggets on Friday.Eastern Conference leaders Detroit also fought to a gritty overtime victory, topping the Cleveland Cavaliers 122-119.
